entries.brief: Create ONE SQUARE original painterly fantasy NPC encyclopedia portrait for SKAZ. Broad sculpted brush shapes, strong head silhouette readable at 40px and in a circular token, moderate detail, soft warm light upper left, deep cool shadows. Head and shoulders three-quarter view, fills 75% of square, keep 10% transparent safe margin all around, especially above head. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No scenery, text, letters, frame, logo, UI symbols or floating effects. A confident weathered human woman bandit captain with dark braided hair, a small old eyebrow scar, alert calculating expression. Worn studded brown leather armor, burgundy scarf, curved scimitar hilt just visible beside one shoulder and a modest dagger sheath. Practical outlaw leader, no crown, no plate armor, no pirate hat, no oversized jewelry. Distinct angular face and compact silhouette.
